{"question":"按叙述顺序仅检索倒悬钟楼记录1及此前章节。","operation":"chapter-cutoff","view":"author","branch":"canon","retrievalStatus":"matched","diagnostics":[],"documents":[{"documentId":"D1","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"第六日乔素装回配重，钟锤恢复运行，修钟目标完成；许砚沿用第五日的判断仍在查找雷痕。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-KPHO","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A160a126d-22c4-4328-ba44-0d2876b193d2:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:160a126d-22c4-4328-ba44-0d2876b193d2"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["第六日乔素装回配重，钟锤恢复运行，修钟目标完成；许砚沿用第五日的判断仍在查找雷痕。"]},{"documentId":"D2","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"世界时间第二日凌晨，钟师乔素取下配重，钟楼因此停摆；这段往事在第八段叙述中才揭示。钟楼机械规约写明：缺少配重时钟锤不能自动运行。楼梯上的油漆呈暗蓝色。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-KPHO","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A6a26ef71-82ad-48a0-a581-479c14d4f21a:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:6a26ef71-82ad-48a0-a581-479c14d4f21a"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["世界时间第二日凌晨，钟师乔素取下配重，钟楼因此停摆；这段往事在第八段叙述中才揭示。钟楼机械规约写明：缺少配重时钟锤不能自动运行。楼梯上的油漆呈暗蓝色。"]},{"documentId":"D3","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"第五日许砚听到雷击说，误以为停摆由雷击造成；乔素知道自己取下了配重。调查者依据第二日取下配重的记录，确认停摆早于第三日的雷雨。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-KPHO","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Aa9bb7ac6-6a19-41f9-a6c3-dd573d5668a7:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:a9bb7ac6-6a19-41f9-a6c3-dd573d5668a7"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["第五日许砚听到雷击说，误以为停摆由雷击造成；乔素知道自己取下了配重。调查者依据第二日取下配重的记录，确认停摆早于第三日的雷雨。"]},{"documentId":"D4","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"补瓦匠在西屋更换三片瓦，工钱按瓦片数量结算，与钟楼机械无关。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-KPHO","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Aff8e49ed-1132-44f0-8ff1-1f7bb9f6da68:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:ff8e49ed-1132-44f0-8ff1-1f7bb9f6da68"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["补瓦匠在西屋更换三片瓦，工钱按瓦片数量结算，与钟楼机械无关。"]}]}
